---
title: "Dashboard filtrable de ejemplo"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

df <- resumen_dia
```

## Filtros {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput(
  inputId = "species",
  label   = "Especie:",
  choices = c("Todas", sort(unique(df$Species))),
  selected = "Todas"
)

sliderInput(
  inputId = "sepal_min",
  label   = "Sepal.Length mínimo:",
  min     = floor(min(df$Sepal.Length)),
  max     = ceiling(max(df$Sepal.Length)),
  value   = floor(min(df$Sepal.Length)),
  step    = 0.5
)
```

## Lógica del servidor

```{r}
#| context: server

datos_filtrados <- reactive({
  out <- df |> dplyr::filter(Sepal.Length >= input$sepal_min)

  if (input$species != "Todas") {
    out <- out |> dplyr::filter(Species == input$species)
  }

  out
})

output$tabla <- DT::renderDataTable({
  DT::datatable(
    datos_filtrados(),
    options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
})

output$plot <- renderPlot({
  datos_filtrados() |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme_minimal()
})
```

## Tabla filtrada

```{r}
DT::dataTableOutput("tabla")
```

## Gráfico filtrado

```{r}
plotOutput("plot")
```
